name: Edit Studio
intro: Edit Studio is a gallery of sixteen focused AI photo tools. Pick one, upload a photo, adjust a few settings, and apply the edit.

features.remove-object: Remove Object lets you paint over anything unwanted with the brush, then erase or clear if you slip. Paint a little beyond the object so the AI sees the surroundings.
features.remove-background: Remove Background gives you a clean cut-out with a transparent background. It has no settings, and it's great for product shots, profile pictures and stickers.
features.extend-image: Extend Image paints in more scene around the edges of your photo, so you can widen a crop or add breathing room around a subject.
features.ai-edit: AI Edit is the most flexible tool. Upload a photo and describe the change you want, like making it night time, then pick an aspect ratio and quality.
features.reframe: Reframe changes the shape of your photo. Choose a new aspect ratio and the AI fills the new space, handy for turning landscape into vertical.
features.change-dress: Change Dress is a virtual try-on. Upload a photo of a person and a photo of the outfit, and the outfit goes onto them.
features.add-watermark: Add Watermark overlays your logo on a photo. Choose its position, opacity and size to brand or protect your pictures.
features.photo-effects: Photo Effects offers one-click looks from a grid of presets, across three models, so you get creative styles without writing a prompt.

outro: Those are the essentials of Edit Studio. Pick the tool that fits the job, and chain edits together to get exactly the photo you want.
